id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

generatedImports.description: The map of generated imports from {@link Ann#UiImportGenerator} that are of the structure {importName:  import object, function, string, etc.}

inactivityWarningModal.description: The modal to be shown when the user has been inactive for the time specified in {@link UiSdlSecurityConfig#inactivityWarningPeriod}.

initialRoute.description: The route that determines what page will be rendered first.

initialParams.description: The params passed to the page on first render

currentPage.description: The metadata ID of the current page.

routes.description: The available routes for this site.

styles.description: A list of styles available to the application.

themeId.description: The id of the current style. Should correspond to a {@link UiSdlThemeTemplate#id}.

densityId.description: The id of the current style. Should correspond to a {@link UiSdlDensityTemplate#id}.

themeHiddenId.description: Private field to represent a `themeId` that can't yet be found. This is required to limit the number of network requests made searching for {@link UiSdlThemeTemplate}

densityHiddenId.description: Private field to represent a `densityId` that can't yet be found. This is required to limit the number of network requests made searching for {@link UiSdlDensityTemplate}

densityDataSpec.description: Data spec to get the available densities.

styleDataSpec.description: Data spec to get the available themes.

densityCollection.description: Storage place for the most recent {@link UiSdlDensityTemplate} fetched.

themeCollection.description: Storage place for the most recent {@link UiSdlThemeTemplate} fetched.

onlyAllowMatchingRoutes.description:
A list of RegExp patterns that indicate what routes can be handled by the router.

If a route doesn't match any pattern, it will be ignored and reported via
{@see onUnhandledRoute}.

webWorkers.description: A map of WebWorkers that the site holds.

useBrowserHistory.description:
If true, a browser history listener will be initialized and
used as source for the initial url and redirects will be published
to the browser history so the address bar is updated.

Default value is 'false' because that is the most common use when a UiSdlSite has to be created
manually. The DefaultSite, the one used when no explicit UiSdlSite is created, is
using the browser history.

user.description: Contains the user object in the redux store. It stores the logged in user's information

configs.description: Contains the configs object in the redux store. It stores the site configuration information
